profile.headline: cs @ gmu | swe intern @ parsons | ex-swe intern @ costar
profile.summary: Feel free to connect or reach out at danunguyen.work@gmail.com

positions.title: Peer Mentor
positions.description: • Held office hours to provide one-on-one guidance, helping students navigate both class assignments and personal projects.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description: • Help students navigate recitation sessions and hosted office hours to support understanding of course material.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - CS 112, CS 211, CS 310
positions.description:
- Assist students across 5 labs in learning programming in Python.
- Assist students in 1 lab Object-Oriented Programming in Java.
- Troubleshoot the student's code and provide guidance on best practices for coding efficiency and problem-solving.
- Offer support in understanding key programming concepts and debugging techniques.
- Answering questions students have on Piazza, an online Q&A platform for students, regarding their programming assignments and providing detailed explanations 2-3 hours/week

positions.title: RISE scholar
positions.description:
- Research & Interdisciplinary STEM Experiences (RISE) Scholars Program
- Implemented qualitative interviews with Healthcare professionals at a local private hospital in Vietnam to gain insights into persisting problems in this field.
- Conducted research about electronic health record (EHR) policies and their implementation in Vietnam.
- Produced a literature review and proposal for research.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the organizing team to plan and develop a comprehensive beginner’s guide, enhancing the hackathon experience for first-time participants, driving a 65% rise in project submissions.
• Coordinated with sponsors to organize 10 technical workshops for students, providing hands-on learning opportunities and expanding participants’ skills.

positions.title: Sponsor Team
positions.description: • Reached out to industry professionals and companies, successfully securing ~$75000 in funding.

positions.title: Tech Fellow
positions.description:
• Managed and mentored 4 groups of 4–6 students across 48 class sessions.
• Provided guidance on fundamental and advanced data structures and algorithms topics, including arrays, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting algorithms, greedy algorithms, and dynamic programming.

positions.title: Web Committee Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the syllabus submission pipeline using Selenium, BeautifulSoup, and MkDocs to automate data collection for 20+ professors in the CS Deparment, retrieve and display 60+ syllabus into dynamic webpage
• Crawled data from the department's technical report website since 1990s, extracting 150+ PDF files using Flask, Selenium, and BeautifulSoup, reducing manual workloads by 96%
